objective: Preallocate SHOW USERS output buffers from known user and permission counts.

tasks.title: Preallocate SHOW USERS output buffers
tasks.result: SHOW USERS result construction now preallocates user rows, per-user permission strings, and per-table privilege lists from known collection sizes.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The change preserves SHOW USERS columns, user rows, superuser flags, permission formatting, and no-permission display.
